name: octocode-mcp
description: Code research MCP server for GitHub, npm, local files, and LSP semantics
long_description: MCP server with code research tools across GitHub, npm, local files, and LSP semantics. Agents orient, search, read exact evidence, and prove findings with typed continuations and sanitized output.

tools.name: clasify
tools.description: Screen text or images with structured factual questions (beta: requires OCTOCODE_BETA and OCTOCODE_CLASSIFICATION_API)

tools.name: ghSearchRepo
tools.description: Find GitHub repositories or repository facts

tools.name: ghSearchCode
tools.description: Find code and paths in GitHub's default-branch index

tools.name: ghStructure
tools.description: Explore GitHub files, refs and languages

tools.name: ghGetFileContent
tools.description: Read GitHub source at a known path and revision

tools.name: ghSearchHistory
tools.description: Find GitHub PRs, issues and commits

tools.name: ghGetHistoryItem
tools.description: Read GitHub discussions, changes and comparisons

tools.name: artifactSearch
tools.description: Resolve registry package releases, dependencies and source

tools.name: localSearch
tools.description: Find text or regex matches in local files

tools.name: structureSearch
tools.description: Explore local directories and find file paths

tools.name: astSearch
tools.description: Find syntax patterns, declarations and syntax trees

tools.name: localFetch
tools.description: Read local source regions or file outlines

tools.name: lspSearch
tools.description: Resolve symbols, references, calls, types and diagnostics

github_token.title: GitHub Token
github_token.description: Personal access token for GitHub API (optional, increases rate limits)
